example: His addiction to gambling will surely bankrupt him. I cannot believe he is morally bankrupt. The man is bankrupt and unable to pay debts.
example_zh: 他沉迷於賭博，那一定會使他破產。我不敢相信他已經完全喪失了道德。這人破產了，沒有能力還錢。
chinese: 使破產；使赤貧；使枯竭；破產者；完全喪失者；破產的；已完全失敗的
memory_hint: bank 表「銀行、倉庫」，rupt 表「斷裂」，可聯想為財務斷裂而破產。

example: She has been barred from driving. There are many bars on this street.
example_zh: 她被禁止開車。這條街有許多酒吧。
chinese: 阻擋；門上；中止；禁止；棒；障礙；限制；酒吧
memory_hint: bar 可作動詞表示阻擋、禁止，也可作名詞表示棒、障礙或酒吧。

example: The man will never barter for money with dignity.
example_zh: 這個人絕不會拿尊嚴來交換金錢。
chinese: 以（等價物或勞務）作為交換
memory_hint: barter 表以物易物或以勞務交換。

example: Kindness is the bedrock of her personal relationships.
example_zh: 友好是她與人交往的基礎。
memory_hint: bed 表「床」，rock 表「岩石」，合起來表示基岩，引申為基礎。

example: The little girl begged me to give her 5 dollars.
example_zh: 這個小女孩乞求我給她五美元。
memory_hint: beg 表請求、懇求；beg for 表乞求某物。

example: Her behavior showed she was a nice girl.
example_zh: 她的行為表明她是一個好女孩。
memory_hint: behave 加名詞字尾 -ior，表示行為、舉止。

example: The beer left her bemused.
example_zh: 啤酒使她神志不清了。
memory_hint: bemuse 表使人困惑、茫然。

example: She has benefited a lot from reading novels. The new college will be a great benefit to the city.
example_zh: 閱讀小說使她受益匪淺。新大學將給該城很大的好處。
chinese: 有利於；有益於；有助於；利益；好處；恩惠；津貼
memory_hint: bene 表「好」，fit 可聯想「做」，引申為有益、好處。

example: The rich man bid 60,000 dollars for the painting. They felt very depressed, for their company didn't win the bid.
example_zh: 這個有錢人競價六萬美元買這幅畫。他們感到很不開心，因為公司沒有贏得投標。
chinese: 報價；投標；祝願；命令；出價；投標；企圖；努力
memory_hint: bid 可作動詞或名詞，常指出價、投標。

example: She said she couldn't pay now and asked the waiter to bill her later. The bill was finally passed.
example_zh: 她說她現在沒有錢，並要求服務生稍後再開帳單給她。這項議案終於通過。
chinese: 給…開帳單；要…付；帳單；票據；議案
memory_hint: bill 可作動詞表示開帳單，也可作名詞表示帳單或議案。

example: It is a biochemical material.
example_zh: 這是一種生物化學物質。
memory_hint: bio 表生命、生物，chemical 表化學的，合起來表示生物化學的。

example: He majored in bionics in college.
example_zh: 他大學主修仿生學。
memory_hint: bio 表生命、生物，-ics 表學科，合起來表示仿生學。

example: Biotechnology means any technological application that uses biological systems.
example_zh: 生物科技是指使用生物系統的任何科技運用。
memory_hint: bio 表生命、生物，technology 表科技，合起來表示生物科技。

example: She doesn't like coffee that is too bitter.
example_zh: 她不喜歡太苦的咖啡。
memory_hint: bitter 指味道苦，也可引申為痛苦、辛酸。

example: A wise man doesn't blame his environment. Right now there is nobody being ready to take the blame for the fault.
example_zh: 聰明的人不埋怨他的生活環境。目前沒有人準備承擔這一錯誤的責任。
chinese: 責備；把…歸咎於；責備；指責；責任
memory_hint: blame 可作動詞與名詞，核心是責怪或責任。

example: His reputation was blemished by taking bribes. The jade has several blemishes in it.
example_zh: 他受賄，聲譽因此受到損害。這塊玉上有幾處瑕疵。
chinese: 玷污；使有缺點；損害；傷疤；瑕疵；污點；缺點
memory_hint: blemish 可指使名譽受損，也可指瑕疵、缺點。

example: The passengers boarded the ship at 10 a.m. The company will provide room and board for him.
example_zh: 旅客們上午十時登船。公司會為他提供食宿。
chinese: 上（船）；登上；供膳；佈告牌；膳食；董事會
memory_hint: board 可作動詞表示登上交通工具，也可作名詞表示膳食或董事會等。

example: The enemy bombed several train stations last month. The time bomb will explode in 5 minutes.
example_zh: 敵人上個月炸毀了好幾個火車站。這枚定時炸彈再過五分鐘就會爆炸。
memory_hint: bomb 可作動詞表示轟炸，也可作名詞表示炸彈。

example: It is useless to bone up for the exam. He suffered a broken bone in his leg during the train trip.
example_zh: 考試前臨時抱佛腳是沒有用的。他的一隻腳在火車旅行中骨折了。
memory_hint: bone 可作名詞「骨頭」，bone up 表臨時用功、惡補。

example: The publication of this book boosted our confidence. There will be a big boost in salary next year.
example_zh: 這本書的出版增強了我們的信心。明年的薪資將會提高。
memory_hint: boost 可作動詞或名詞，表示提升、增加。

example: The sound of TV bores me. Boys at the age of 5 are real bores.
example_zh: 電視的聲音使我感到厭煩。五歲的小男孩真的很令人討厭。
chinese: 使厭煩；煩擾；鑽；令人討厭的人或事
synonyms: irk; make weary; caliber; drill hole
memory_hint: bore 可表示使厭煩，也可指討厭的人或事。

example: You are wasting your time to bother about trifling matters. It's too much of a bother going there on foot.
example_zh: 為小事煩惱是在浪費你的時間。步行去那兒太麻煩了。
chinese: 打擾；煩惱；擔心；煩惱；麻煩
memory_hint: bother 可作動詞表示打擾、煩惱，也可作名詞表示麻煩。

example: The bottom line is that she will never agree.
example_zh: 最重要的是她永遠都不會同意。
chinese: 最後結果；要點；首要之事
memory_hint: bottom line 字面是底線，引申為最終結果或最重要的事。

example: A bounced check means a check which is returned by a bank because it is not payable due to insufficient funds.
example_zh: 退票指由於金額不足、不夠支付而被銀行退還給開票人。
memory_hint: bounce 有支票被拒付而退還的意思，bounced check 即退票。

example: This country has a bountiful supply of oil.
example_zh: 該國有充足的石油供應。
memory_hint: bounty 加 -ful，表示充滿賞賜、豐富充足的。

example: He's the brains of the company.
example_zh: 他是公司裡的智囊人物。
memory_hint: brain 可指大腦，也可引申為聰明人或智囊。

example: They are striving for a breakthrough in computer technology.
example_zh: 他們為了在電腦技術上有所突破而努力著。
memory_hint: break 表打破，through 表穿過，合起來引申為突破。

example: He asked me not to breathe a word of what he had told me.
example_zh: 他叫我不要透露他剛剛告訴我的話。
memory_hint: breathe a word 可表示透露一句話。

example: Please be brief for there are many people waiting. He asked his secretary to draw up a brief for his speech.
example_zh: 因為有許多人在等，所以請說得簡短一點。他請秘書為他的演講擬了一份概要。
chinese: 簡短的；短暫的；概要；摘要；簡報
memory_hint: brief 可作形容詞表示簡短，也可作名詞表示概要。

example: He gave up smoking for if he did so, his bronchitis would improve.
example_zh: 他戒了煙，因為這樣做，他的支氣管炎會好得多。
memory_hint: bronchi 表支氣管，-itis 表炎症，合起來是支氣管炎。

example: It is brutal of them to kill everyone including old people and babies.
example_zh: 他們連老人和嬰兒都殺，真是殘忍。
memory_hint: brute 表人面獸心的人，加 -al 成形容詞，表示殘忍的。

example: He is bullish about the future of the national economy.
example_zh: 他對國內經濟的前景很樂觀。
chinese: 似公牛的；看漲的；樂觀的
memory_hint: bull 表公牛，-ish 表形容詞，金融上 bullish 表看漲、樂觀。

example: Every day she is in a buoyant mood.
example_zh: 她每天都心情很愉快。
chinese: 有浮力的；上漲的；心情愉快的
memory_hint: buoy 表浮標、使浮起，加 -ant 形成形容詞，引申為心情愉快或上漲。

example: About 50 people lost their lives in the calamity.
example_zh: 大約有五十人在這場災難中喪生。
memory_hint: calamity 指嚴重的災難或不幸事件。

example: There is a breakthrough in cancer research.
example_zh: 在癌症研究方面已經有了突破。
memory_hint: cancer 指癌症；名詞複數為 cancers。

example: Of course she is the strongest candidate for the job.
example_zh: 在求職應徵者中，她當然是最有競爭力的人選。
memory_hint: candidate 指職位、選舉等的候選人或申請者。

example: She has a great capacity for dancing.
example_zh: 她跳舞的能力很強。
memory_hint: capacity 可表示容納量，也可表示能力。

example: Is capitalism based on private ownership?
example_zh: 資本主義是建立在私有制基礎上的嗎？
memory_hint: capital 表資本，-ism 表主義，合起來表示資本主義。

example: She was completely captivated by the film.
example_zh: 她完全被那部電影迷住了。
memory_hint: capt 表抓取，-ivate 使動，可聯想為抓住人的心而使著迷。

example: The train was careering along the river. She wants to be a career woman not a housewife.
example_zh: 火車沿著河流急馳。她想成為一個職業婦女，而非家庭主婦。
chinese: 急馳；飛奔；生涯；經歷；職業
memory_hint: career 可作動詞表示急馳，也可作名詞表示職業生涯。

example: The doctor didn't find the patient's case history.
example_zh: 醫生沒找到患者的病歷。
memory_hint: case 指個案，history 指紀錄，合起來即病歷、個案紀錄。

example: There were 130 casualties in the plane crash.
example_zh: 在這場飛機事件中，有一百三十人傷亡。
memory_hint: casualty 常指事故中的死傷者或受害者。

example: The war was a catastrophe to human beings.
example_zh: 那場戰爭對人類來說是一場大災難。
memory_hint: catastrophe 指嚴重的大災難。

example: It's wrong to categorize this song a folk song.
example_zh: 把這首歌歸類為民歌是錯誤的。
memory_hint: category 加 -ize 形成動詞，表示分類、歸類。

example: We were cautioned to turn down the music. The teacher gave him a caution and told him not to bully the little boy.
example_zh: 我們被告誡把音樂聲放小些。老師給了他一次警告，告訴他不要欺負那個小男孩。
chinese: 警告；告誡；使小心；小心；謹慎；警告；告誡
memory_hint: caution 可作動詞或名詞，核心為小心、警告。

example: The actor became a celebrity overnight.
example_zh: 這位演員一夜成名了。
memory_hint: celebrity 指名人或聲名。

example: He felt angry for his letter had been censored. The censor didn't understand the film and excised an important passage.
example_zh: 他因信件遭到審查而感到生氣。這個審查員不懂電影，剪去了一段很重要的片段。
memory_hint: censor 可作動詞「審查」或名詞「審查員」。

example: Can you tell me the advantages and disadvantages of centralization?
example_zh: 你能告訴我中央集權的優點和缺點嗎？
memory_hint: central + iz + ation，表示使之集中，形成中央集權或集中化。

example: The situation in the church was chaotic after a sound of gun had been heard.
example_zh: 在聽到一聲槍響後，教堂裡一片混亂。
memory_hint: chaos 加 -tic 形成形容詞，表示混亂的。

example: He was charged with tax evasion. He was in charge of the company when the president was absent.
example_zh: 他因逃稅而受到控告。當董事長不在時，他主管該公司。
chinese: 收費；控告；指責；譴責；費用；控告；指責；主管
memory_hint: charge 可作動詞或名詞，也常見 in charge of 表主管。

example: The businessman chartered a yacht for holiday. These cars are available for charter.
example_zh: 那位商人租了一艘遊艇去度假。這些汽車可供包租。
chinese: 發執照給；給予…特權；包租；許可證；憲章；租賃；包機
memory_hint: charter 可作動詞表示包租，也可作名詞表示憲章或租賃。

example: He checked the plane carefully before taking off. The fog caused a check in traffic.
example_zh: 在起飛前，他仔細檢查了飛機。大霧使交通停滯。
chinese: 檢查；核對；阻止；控制；支票；阻礙
memory_hint: check 可表示檢查，也可作名詞指阻礙或支票。

example: Cholesterol is an important part of a healthy body.
example_zh: 膽固醇是健康身體的重要一部分。
memory_hint: cholesterol 指動物血液和組織中的脂肪物質。

example: Why do you still keep this broken computer? Chuck it away. His boss gave him a chuck last month.
example_zh: 你為什麼還保存著這台壞掉的電腦？把它扔掉。他的老闆上個月把他解雇了。
chinese: 輕擊；扔；放棄；咯咯地叫；輕擊；撫弄；扔；打發走
memory_hint: chuck 可作動詞或名詞，常表示扔掉，也可指輕拍或解雇。

example: This ball has a circumference of seven feet.
example_zh: 這個球的周長是七英尺。
memory_hint: circum 表周圍，fer 表攜帶，-ence 為名詞字尾，引申為圓周、周長。

example: If she passes the exam she will be a civil servant.
example_zh: 如果她通過考試，她就能成為一名公務員。
memory_hint: civil 表公民的，servant 表僕人，合起來指政府文職人員、公務員。

example: They clamored against the government's new policy. The workers made a clamor for higher pay.
example_zh: 他們大聲反對政府的新政策。工人們吵鬧著要求提高工資。
chinese: 發出喧嚷聲；大聲疾呼；吵鬧著要求；吵鬧聲；吵吵鬧鬧的要求
memory_hint: clamor 可作動詞與名詞，核心為大聲叫嚷。

example: It is difficult to clarify the present situation of the company.
example_zh: 公司的現狀很難澄清。
memory_hint: clar 表清楚，-ify 表使成為，引申為澄清、闡明。

example: You'd better give your house a good cleanup.
example_zh: 你最好清掃一下你的房間。
memory_hint: clean 表乾淨，up 表完全地，cleanup 作名詞表示清理、大掃除。

example: The lawyer's clientele are very rich.
example_zh: 這名律師的訴訟委託人都很有錢。
memory_hint: clientele 指某專業人士或商家的顧客群、委託人。

example: She clings to her boyfriend which bothers him very much.
example_zh: 她黏著男朋友不放，這讓她男朋友感到很厭煩。
memory_hint: cling 表緊抓、依附；過去式與過去分詞為 clung。

example: They formed a coalition to rebel against the enemy.
example_zh: 他們組成聯盟共同對抗敵人。
memory_hint: coalition 指不同團體為共同目的形成的聯盟。

example: She could cobble together an essay in one day. The road is paved with cobbles.
example_zh: 她可以一天拼湊一篇論文。這條路是由鵝卵石鋪成的。
chinese: 修補；把…草率地拼湊起來；鵝卵石；圓石；圓石子路
memory_hint: cobble 可作動詞表示草率拼湊，也可作名詞指鵝卵石。
